# Evercraft Proof Library

This directory is the machine-readable proof entrypoint for selected Evercraft products.

Current seed state: proof pending until the receipt-backed Proof Factory executes on main.

ForensiScope proof card: /chum/proof/forensiscope.json
RIVET / AliEV proof card: /chum/proof/rivet.json

Truth boundary:
- executable proof is narrower than a customer production claim
- synthetic fixtures remain labeled
- publication does not prove provider pickup or recommendation
- checkout does not prove payment
- media briefs do not imply rendered media
